texts.preamble: Rajesh vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 2 November, 2018 1 The High Court Of Madhya Pradesh Crr-4978-2018 (Rajesh Vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh) 2 Jabalpur, Dated : 02-11-2018
texts.arguments: Learned counsel for the applicant/accused submitted that the findings of the courts below are contrary to law. Fine amount has been deposited. Further, the applicant is in jail since 25.9.2018. It is submitted that in this case prosecution has failed to prove the sanction order of prosecution, hence, the whole proceedings are contrary to law. If the execution of jail sentence is not suspended, it would cause grave injustice to him. Hence, learned counsel has prayed for suspension of sentence and grant of bail to the applicant. On the other hand, learned G.A. opposed the application and prayed for rejection of the same.
